title: Stalk tensor multiplication range
statement: Under the hypotheses and notation of the ideal multiplication stalk range theorem, before replacing the multiplication map by its image inclusion, the range of the stalk multiplication map is the ideal generated by the stalk image of ι times the top submodule of the stalk of F.

proof.text: Use the proved upstream AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.leftUnitor_hom_app_tmulSection to compute the sheaf left unitor on the image of a sectionwise pure tensor under the sheafification unit and tensorObjIsoSheafification inverse. The definitions of tmulSection and unitSectionsEquiv identify this with sectionwise scalar multiplication; no new coherence lemma is needed.

Choose the existing stalk tensor comparison Φ with its germ formula and naturality. Represent a vector in the unit stalk and a vector in F_x by germs and restrict both to the intersection of their neighborhoods. The inverse comparison sends their pure tensor to the tensor-section germ. The upstream left-unitor formula from step 1, functoriality of germs, and he identify its image with e(a) • b. Apply naturality of Φ along ι and the identity of F to obtain that the stalk multiplication sends Φ.inv(a ⊗ b) to (S.map ι ≫ e.hom)(a) • b.

Transport a stalk tensor to the ordinary tensor product using Φ. Tensor induction, linearity, and Submodule.smul_mem_smul show its multiplication image belongs to range(S.map ι ≫ e.hom) • top. For the converse apply Submodule.smul_le: for each scalar in the range choose its preimage a, and use Φ.inv(a ⊗ b) as a preimage of the scalar multiple of any b. Antisymmetry gives equality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01AG and 01CB; H2 formal proof uses the proved upstream leftUnitor_hom_app_tmulSection and the existing stalkTensorIso germ formula and naturality, followed by tensor induction.

lean.statement: theorem stalk_tensor_multiplication_range {X : Scheme.{u}} {J : X.Modules} (ι : J ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (F : X.Modules) (x : X) (e : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≅ ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (he : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (r : Γ(X, U)), e.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf U x hx r) = X.presheaf.germ U x hx r) : letI : MonoidalCategory X.Modules := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf let S := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x LinearMap.range (S.map (ι ▷ F ≫ (λ_ F).hom)).hom = (LinearMap.range (S.map ι ≫ e.hom).hom : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) • (⊤ : Submodule (X.presheaf.stalk x) (S.obj F))
